territorial_contact_reconciliation.coordinate_rule: Longitude (360*x + 180 - 180*262166) / 262166; latitude native-row-latitudes.f64le[row.y] decoded as little-endian IEEE-754 binary64. Source GeoJSON coordinates are evaluated as stored; no CRS/datum transformation, snapping, or normalization.
territorial_contact_reconciliation.method: Even-odd point-in-ring over each Polygon/MultiPolygon, respecting interior rings; centers are tested separately against each full pinned operand. A boundary result would be retained as unresolved; none occurred.
